name: Toaster World
summary:
Welcome to Toaster World!
Imagine Earth in the year 2045 if some idiot decided to build SmartToasters with viruses in them. That's basically what happened here. All humans are gone, and all that's left are Toasters.

"TOASTER GAME OF THE YEAR 2045" - FICTIONAL TOASTER VIDEO GAME MAGAZINE
- Explore the various maps with your friends and hang out in Multiplayer, or mess with the maps in Sandbox mode with your friends!

LOTS OF CUSTOMIZATION
- Customize your toaster by wearing hats, changing the screen color,
